reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reads the death-appointed-once rule as covering humanity in general, explicitly carving out Enoch and Elijah as recorded exceptions.

sides.snippet: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.
sides.verseText: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.

sides.snippet: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
